The '''mangle tree''' was a massive [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. The trees were the planet's primary [[Plant/Legends|flora]], and grew to nearly 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height, rivaling some of<ref name="LoNH" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk's]] [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] in size. With the appearance of a massive knot of tentacles, mangle trees rose out of the [[Water/Legends|waters]] of Vodran's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and bayous on piles of [[Atmosphere/Legends|aerial]] prop roots.<ref name="LoNH" />

Multiple [[City/Legends|cities]] and settlements were built within the branches of Vodran's mangle trees. The trees' lower branches were also used by the planet's [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], who waited for [[Dianoga/Legends|dianogas]]&mdash;a massive species of [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] native to Vodran&mdash;to pop their [[Ommatophora|eyestalks]] above the water's surface before shooting them with a [[Vodran hunting rifle]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mangle tree was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
